title: OpenAI launches a legal model configuration with searchable US authority
friendlyTitle: OpenAI adds a version of Astra designed for legal work
summary: Astra for Law combines GPT-6 Astra with legal instructions, a search index spanning US case law and regulation, and 26 integrations for specialist tools. OpenAI reports a 54% all-pass rate on a private 200-question Vals legal-research set, versus 38.7% for Astra with ordinary web search.
friendlySummary: Astra for Law searches US legal sources and connects to tools used by law firms. OpenAI says it performed better than normal web search in its own legal research test.
whyItMatters: Domain-specific retrieval and workflow controls may be more valuable than a general model upgrade for professional work. Lawyers still need to inspect cited authority, protect confidential material and retain responsibility for advice because the published evaluation is vendor-run and not proof of reliability in every matter.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Special legal search may save time, but lawyers must still check every source and protect client information. The company’s own test is not a guarantee.
